title: Finland: what a €5,000,000 yearly budget should buy first against lung cancer delays
markdown:
# Finland: what a €5,000,000 yearly budget should buy first against lung cancer delays

## The gap in one sentence
No measured county indicator is loaded for this national view, so there is no measured gap to rank. The model estimates 155 days (149–162) from first symptom to treatment start [^model]. That total is anchored to 155 days reported by Yle in 2026 from an unpublished four-city Finnish study, not a national statistic [^src_yle_fi_a_74_20250979].

## Where the days are lost
The longest estimated step is first symptom to first primary care contact, at 56 days (52–61) [^model]. The material lists no measured drivers for it. The source says only "over 50 days" [^src_yle_fi_a_74_20242733].

Diagnosis to treatment start is the one step measured by the Finnish Cancer Registry: 36.9 days nationally, 1.1.2018–30.6.2022, a mean of the registry's measured medians for surgery, radiotherapy and drug therapy weighted by the national treatment mix [^fcr_lung_quality_report_pdf]. For surgery, the collaborative-area median ranges from 13.5 days in Northern Finland (OYS) to 46.0 days in Southern Finland (HUS); these are area values, not county values [^src_fi_assets_files_2024_12_Keuhkosyopa_Suomessa_pdf_p28].

## Three actions
The three top-ranked picks are the same symptom campaign in three counties [^model]. Across the whole plan, the model spends €4,993,287 and estimates 43.57 deaths avoided a year (31.56–56.09) [^model].

1. **What:** Run a symptom-awareness campaign in Lapland telling people with a cough lasting over three weeks to see a doctor [^model]. **Owner:** FICAN and the Cancer Society nationally; county communications and primary care locally [^model]. **Cost:** €13,931 a year [^model]. This is scaled from a sourced roadmap budget, and repeating it yearly is an assumption [^model]. **Expected effect:** 0 days saved and an estimated 0.57 deaths avoided a year [^model]. **Evidence:** [^ev_symptom_campaign_1] [^ev_symptom_campaign_2] [^ev_symptom_campaign_3]. **Roadmap:** 1.3.2, Promote early presentation with a national communication plan that raises awareness of cancer symptoms [^roadmap_1.3.2].
2. **What:** The same campaign in Kymenlaakso [^model]. **Owner:** As above [^model]. **Cost:** €12,510 a year [^model]. **Expected effect:** 0 days saved and an estimated 0.48 deaths avoided a year [^model]. **Evidence:** [^ev_symptom_campaign_1] [^ev_symptom_campaign_2] [^ev_symptom_campaign_3]. **Roadmap:** 1.3.2 [^roadmap_1.3.2].
3. **What:** The same campaign in South Savo [^model]. **Owner:** As above [^model]. **Cost:** €10,518 a year [^model]. **Expected effect:** 0 days saved and an estimated 0.36 deaths avoided a year [^model]. **Evidence:** [^ev_symptom_campaign_1] [^ev_symptom_campaign_2] [^ev_symptom_campaign_3]. **Roadmap:** 1.3.2 [^roadmap_1.3.2].

## What to measure from Monday
- Days from referral to the first pulmonology visit for suspected lung cancer, by county [^model]
- Days from first specialist visit to diagnosis by hospital, and diagnosis to treatment start by county [^model]
- Stage at diagnosis and the share treated with curative intent, by county [^model]
- Date of first symptom or first primary care contact, linked to the Cancer Registry [^model]

## Limits of this analysis
Most of the step days are estimates, not measurements of individual pathways. Steps 3 and 4 split a residual of 21 days by assumption [^model]. As a check, not a validation, none of the 3 outcomes correlated with the estimated clock beyond chance; curative intent pointed the expected way (rho −0.30, permutation p 0.17) [^model].
